steps.note: Open the Single Stage event creation flow.
Switch the event type to a buy auction and configure its auction mode.
Provide the mandatory event title before publishing.
Apply a reverse-auction template so the pricing sheet is available.
Add the specified product as the first line with quantity 10.
Complete the pricing sheet setup for the added line item.
